run_clc_benchmark: run the CLC benchmark sweep for dense, varlen, and block-sparse flash attention configurations
generate_benchmark_cases: generate benchmark test cases from dense, varlen, and block-sweep sweep configurations with optional case filter
profile_flash_attention_cases: profile flash attention forward passes with CLC enabled and disabled to measure speedup and TFLOPS
compile_flash_attention_kernels: compile flash attention CUDA kernels in parallel across multiple worker processes for each case and CLC setting
write_benchmark_results_csv: write benchmark profile results to a CSV file with rounded float values and metadata for each test case
